blueprints.description: A self-service portal for customers: an account home, their orders and invoices, a support inbox and their own profile.

screens.name: portal.home
screens.title: Home
screens.description: Your account at a glance: open orders, what you owe and what happened lately.

screens.name: portal.orders
screens.title: Orders
screens.description: Your orders and where each one is.

screens.name: portal.order
screens.title: Order
screens.description: One order: key facts, its lines, tracking and what happened to it.

screens.name: portal.invoices
screens.title: Invoices
screens.description: Your invoices and which ones are still to pay.

screens.name: portal.support
screens.title: Support
screens.description: Your conversations with us: questions, reminders and quotes.

screens.name: portal.profile
screens.title: Profile
screens.description: Your details, delivery address and preferences.

templates.name: PortalHome
templates.description: Open orders, what is owed, open support requests, spend by month, your latest orders and what happened lately.

templates.name: PortalOrdersList
templates.description: The customer's own orders with placed and delivery dates, total and status, filtered by status and date.

templates.name: PortalOrderPage
templates.description: One of your orders: status, total, items and days to delivery, its details, lines and tracking, and what happened to it.

templates.name: PortalInvoicesList
templates.description: The customer's invoices with issue and due dates, amount and whether each is paid, filtered by status and date.

templates.name: PortalSupport
templates.description: Conversations with the supplier: the queue grouped by day with unread told in words, the open message and its history.

templates.name: PortalProfile
templates.description: The signed-in customer contact: their team, tabbed details, preferences and security, and recent activity.

templates.name: PortalQuickCreateReorder
templates.description: A short form that creates one order without leaving the page.

templates.name: PortalNewSupportRequest
templates.displayName: Customer portal quick create support request
templates.description: A short form that creates one support request without leaving the page.
